caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest or box with a hinged lid, decorated in a folk art style. The main colors used are shades of beige, red, blue, yellow, and green. The lid and side panels of the box are adorned with floral motifs, featuring large, detailed flowers; the front panel shows a central red flower flanked by two yellow flowers, all surrounded by green leaves, inside a beige frame bordered with red. The top of the lid displays two large red flowers with green foliage and a few small blue elements, and is bordered by a blue background with white polka dots and a wavy red edge. The left vertical edge includes a blue-and-red striped diagonal pattern, which continues across the front lip of the lid. The side panel that is visible includes a red flower and a blue flower with green leaves on a plain beige background, bordered with a red line. The remaining surfaces of the box are decorated with a muted, wood-grain-like beige, and some parts have a swirled or patterned texture in lighter beige tones.
title: Utility Box
